inputs.goal: Add a truncate helper to src/text.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `truncate(s: string, max: number): string` in src/text.ts. A string of at most `max` characters is returned unchanged; a longer one is cut so that the result, INCLUDING a trailing "…" (one character), is exactly `max` characters. `max` below 1 throws a RangeError. Count characters, not UTF-16 code units, so an emoji is never split. Add tests.
